meta.description: Documented historical Vietjet/Jetstar promotions relevant to SYD-SGN. Advertised/listed fares only - none verified as bookable.

rules.relevance: High = Sydney-Vietnam evidenced AND lead time >= 9 months; Medium = Sydney or Australia-Vietnam evidenced with lead 6-9 months, or Australia-only with longer lead, or long-running series; Low = lead < 6 months, generic route evidence, or different airport; Unknown = travel window missing/ambiguous. Evidence categories only - NOT a probability of a future sale.
rules.lead_time: Months from booking end (else publish date) to last eligible travel date.
rules.recurring_label: 'historically recurring' only when observed in 2+ distinct years; otherwise 'previously observed'. Absence of a record means 'not found'.
rules.evidence_quality: official = airline page; press = media article repeating airline release; deal_site = OzBargain/Beat That Flight/I Know The Pilot listing.
rules.covers_aug_nov_2027: none/partial/full/unknown = whether the stated travel window reaches 1 Aug-15 Nov 2027 departures. For listings the window is the sample range shown.

caveats: Sampling bias: records were found via search; coverage is uneven by month and year.
Deal-site fares are what a poster saw at the time; many pages are stale.
Fares were not tested against live booking pages.
